ModMetaData.name: Dawn of a New Day
ModMetaData.author: AlenDio
ModMetaData.description: Adds a customizable header overlay that displays at the start of the day. Features Go to: Options > Mod options > "Dawn of a New Day" # Enabled: You can toggle the overlay anytime without restarting. # Screenshot Mode: When in Screenshot Mode (F11), if enabled the overlay won't be displayed. # Show Example: Shows your current overlay configuration in the next tick to ease and familarize with the settings. - Appearance Section # Show Highlight: Adds a low-opacity light background behind the overlay. # Scale: Scales the whole overlay to your like. # Offset Presets: Helps you to choose an offset of your liking without trial and error. # Offset (px): Choose offsets on X and Y axis at pixel-precision. # Subtitle Gap (px): Choose the gap value between Bottom and Subtitle. # Line Width (%): Choose the width in percentage of the line that divides the Upper from Bottom. # Line Thickness (px): Choose the thickness in pixels of the line that divides the Upper from Bottom. # Line Padding (px): Choose the padding in pixels that divides the line from the Upper and Bottom. - Duration Section # Total Display Duration: Choose the total duration of the overlay in seconds. # Fade In Duration: Choose the duration of the overlay fading-in in seconds. # Fade Out Duration: Choose the duration of the overlay fading-out in seconds. - Text Section # Choose Font Family: Choose an custom OS font to replace the default game font of the text. # Font Size: Choose the character size of the text. # Outline Thickness: Choose the thickness of the outline of the text. # Bold: Enable to add bold style to the text. # Italic: Enable to add italic style to the text. # Text Color: Choose from the color presets the color of the text. # Outline Color: Choose from the color presets the color of the outline of the text. - Label Format Section # Upper Text Format: Choose the format of the Upper text. # Bottom Text Format: Choose the format of the Bottom text. # Subtitle Text Format: Choose the format of the Subtitle text. # Label Format Presets: Copy a format preset to paste into any Format Text. # Label Format Hints: Copy any format available that you can paste into any Format Text. # Rich Text Hints: Copy any rich text body that you can paste into any Format Text and edit it to your liking. - Sound Section # Enabled: Toggle the sound that starts with the overlay. # Choose Sound: Choose a custom sound from the catalogue. # Sound Volume: Choose the volume of the sound. # Pitch Volume: Choose the pitch of the sound. - Extra Section # Starts at Zero: Enable to start the count of the days from 0 instead of 1. # Show Every X Days: Choose how often the overlay displays [eg. X=10: DAY 10, DAY 20, DAY 30, ...]. # Trigger Hour: Choose at what hour of the day the overlay displays. Can be safely added or removed from existing saves at any time.
